formulas.cosines: cos(grad(total), grad(base)), cos(grad(total), grad(pair)), cos(grad(base), grad(pair))
formulas.lambda_target_x: x / r_median for x in {0.1, 0.25, 1.0}, fixed before scaled gradients are computed
formulas.r_median: median over the three fixed seeds of r_seed (concatenated)
formulas.r_seed: ||grad(L_pair)|| / ||grad(L_base)|| over concatenated (Wt, Wv) at the initial parameters

limitations: lambda=1 的 pair 梯度约为 base 的 1–2%（初始、concat 实测），不足以说明该成对监督会产生可见训练影响。
0.1 / 0.25 / 1.0 只是预先固定的诊断目标 ratio，不是文献标准，也不是精度门槛。
不能从零更新初始梯度推断收敛、验证集改进或任务精度。
本审计不修改 DRAFT、不训练、不给出 promotion / no-promotion 结论，也不授权重训。
所有数值都是 internal teacher/math 初始梯度诊断，不是 CV-Bench 任务精度。

notes.descriptive_not_search: the four candidate scales are fixed before any scaled-gradient number is computed; this is a descriptive gradient-normalisation audit, not a hyper-parameter search, and no winner is declared
notes.no_success_claim: a realised pair/base ratio equal to a diagnostic target does NOT imply convergence, validation improvement or task accuracy
notes.not_task_accuracy: all numbers are internal train-only initial-gradient diagnostics, never CV-Bench task accuracy
notes.zero_update: only forward and autograd.grad are used; no update rule is constructed, no parameter is written, no epoch is run

provenance.input_npz_scope: train split only; aggregate over sorted (sample_id, file sha256)

scale_audit.r_median_definition: median over the three fixed seeds of the initial concatenated pair/base gradient norm ratio

scope: train-only, CPU-only, zero-update scale-stability audit of the DRAFT pair loss; the candidate lambda values are fixed before any scaled-gradient number is computed from the three-seed median initial pair/base ratio; no training, no tuning, no parameter save, no val/test feature cache read, no model load, no GPU, no network, no promotion decision, no accuracy claim
